summary: Backend-only test of the value parsing, dedupe, poll image and Lua script changes. 17/17 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_value_parsing_dedupe.py, run with min_log_value=0. Value parsing works through both /logs/ingest and /script/report: '$1/s' -> 1 ($1/s), '$1.5M/s' -> 1.5M ($1.50M/s), '$25K/s' -> 25000 ($25.00K/s). Generations without '/s' ('$4.5M', '19K', '') are ignored and the base income is used (Noobini 1; Gold 1.25; Diamond 1.5). '?/s' (has /s but no number) also falls back to base. Dedupe: the same job_id+name+mutation is not inserted twice (across requests and inside one batch). A different mutation or a different job_id is inserted. Dedupe ends after 10 minutes (checked by back-dating a log). /script/poll logs include the 'image' field (a wiki URL) with all the other fields. client.lua, selfbot.lua and bot.lua?token= all pass luac5.1 -p and contain: hop() that alternates Teleport(game.PlaceId, LP) with the server-list TeleportToPlaceInstance; readOverhead picking the label that contains '/s'; ViewportFrame from ReplicatedStorage.Models.Animals with a getcustomasset fallback; and addRow(name, image). client.lua has the joiningUntil guard. bot.lua with a bad token is rejected. Cleanup done: temp users, slots, logs and runs removed; min_log_value=1000000; owner_selfbot=true (its original value); owner key/hwid unchanged.

minor.issue: 8 old logs remain from the old Lua with wrong values, e.g. Noobini Pizzanini / Lirilì Larilà / Talpa Di Fero / Svinina Bombardino all at '$14.00M/s' (source selfbot:horloge2021). Users still see wrong prices on the site until these are deleted. I did not delete them (not test data).

Brainrots that are not in BY_NAME (e.g. Mortaruga, Tartaruga Cisterna, Co Co Co Sahur, Los Tralaleritos, seen in existing bot logs) are stored with rarity 'Unknown' and image=null, so the website and panel have no picture for them. With no '/s' generation their value becomes 0 and they are dropped. Consider extending the brainrots catalog.
Dedupe is find-then-insert with no unique index, so two reports for the same server at the same moment could still both insert. Low risk.

action_items: Image fallback: static.wikia.nocookie.net returns image/webp even with 'Accept: image/png'. Roblox getcustomasset most likely cannot decode WebP, so the web-image fallback in brainrotPic will probably show nothing. Fix: append '?format=original' to the image URL (verified: it returns image/png 150x203), either in brainrots.py image URLs or in webImage() in the Lua.
Delete the old wrong-value logs from db.logs (e.g. the '$14.00M/s' Noobini entries) so the site stops showing wrong prices.
Optional: add the missing brainrots (Mortaruga, Tartaruga Cisterna, Co Co Co Sahur, Los Tralaleritos, ...) to brainrots.py so they get rarity, base income and image.
critical_code_review_comments: webImage(): imgCache[url]=false is set before the fetch, so a second row with the same brainrot that is added while the first download is in progress gets nil and never shows an image. Use a pending/wait pattern or retry.
The selfbot addRow passes no image (nil), so it only shows a picture when the model exists in ReplicatedStorage.Models.Animals. Fine but inconsistent with the client.
readOverhead '/s' detection is case-sensitive, and the backend check '"/s" in generation' is too. If the game ever shows '/S', the value is ignored. Consider lower-casing.

Selfbot TeleportInitFailed only updates the status; the loop still waits 6s and rescans the same server (dedupe now prevents duplicate logs, and the next hop() switches to the server list, so this is acceptable).
brainrotPic camera uses cf.LookVector of the bounding box; for models whose pivot faces away, the camera may view the back. Cosmetic.
